records.review_summary: Early stale-battle cleanup protected waiting battles with evidence; current main retains that boundary and additionally handles in-progress joined battles with recovery-safe grace and durable-progress/result exclusions.
Typed session-access failures and contradictory/stale action rejection remain in main; main additionally rejects any resolved lifecycle decision that is no longer resumable.
Duplicate-session preflight remains, while main replaced application-bootstrap reuse with a stricter read-only direct Mongo client that only pings and aggregates and always closes the client.
Answer-ledger length precondition and CAS are preserved in session_integrity; later main adds stricter owner/resumable-state and cancellation protections around the same authority.
Per-recipient durable delivery lease/ack flow is retained; main additionally requires the explicit battle outbox protocol before using that delivery path.

The original outbox migration fence is now a larger migration-boundary test covering durable question progress, semantic callback binding, timer authority, answer CAS, result reconstruction and recovery-safe cleanup.

The branch blocked three dangerous progress fields in generic updates; main uses a stricter allowlist permitting only question_sent_at/status/end_time and therefore blocks all other durable/spec fields.

Sequential durable outbox draining and per-item failure isolation remain; main isolates only typed store outages between queues while preserving explicit error evidence and still fails closed on malformed listings.
Deterministic attempt/question report identity and durable outbox acceptance remain; main additionally keeps this ingress from consuming the normal user report cooldown.

Conditional all-or-nothing live-answer migration guard was replaced by a mandatory production-controller boundary that forbids blind writes and RAM answer mutations and enforces durable acceptance before side effects.
The v2 shutdown no-write requirement is retained and strengthened by the current mandatory production migration boundary and side-effect ordering checks.

Attempt/question target recapture and durable timer CAS remain; main adds strict validation of returned session id, attempt id, question index, applied flag and timer value before RAM synchronization.

Attempt/question/option callback binding remains; main increases option fingerprint from 48 to 72 bits, validates shuffled options against canonical options, rejects ambiguous option fingerprints, and validates durable store transitions before RAM sync.

Completion-safe owner cancellation CAS is preserved: restart classification, attempt identity, counters, question ids and ledger are all bound before cancellation; later session-integrity hardening surrounds the same invariant.

Durable report migration guard is retained and strengthened: normal reports use stable drafts/outbox, direct admin sends are absent, and inaccuracy reports must use their dedicated deterministic-id acceptance helper.
Retry identity no longer binds mutable context/profile metadata; main keeps the reduced immutable snapshot and adds an explicit update_cooldown switch for independent durable ingress paths.
Stable report draft identity, immutable snapshot, durable acceptance before send, and independent pending outbox delivery all remain in current report submission flow.
Lost-response restart replay still returns the durable winner without resetting it; main adds regressions rejecting a non-advanced old attempt and contradictory durable winner state.

Read-only direct-Mongo retention preflight remains and is expanded to Mini App and broadcast retention, with explicit bootstrap_pending only for known broadcast TTLs and fail-closed handling of unrecognized TTLs.
Durable live finalization from owned Mongo evidence remains; current main also carries the later stricter timer/store and lifecycle migration contracts.

Conditional lifecycle migration fence is replaced by a mandatory production-controller contract with attempt-bound lifecycle callbacks, centralized strict status classification, and complete removal of old destructive session APIs.

Historical report delivery-state compatibility bridge is byte-identical in main; the delivery worker is later strengthened with off-event-loop Mongo calls, durable deferral and permanent-failure settlement while retaining acknowledgement safety.
Fail-closed durable quiz-session creation is retained with a typed persistence error; main additionally rejects unacknowledged inserts rather than treating them as durable success.

Two-commit August 9 prototype predates the current architecture: it used PTB 20.7, Gunicorn keep_alive entrypoint, wildcard CORS, debug user_id fallback, always-200 degraded health and offline demo Mini App data. Current main intentionally replaces each of those surfaces with authenticated server-authoritative APIs, fail-closed production readiness, a single production entrypoint, current runtime and reviewed course authority.
GitHub commit graph proves this ref has no commits ahead of reviewed main; its SHA is the merge base and reviewed main is 506 commits ahead.
